title: Corporation Tax: assessments (CT220 Notes)
text: These notes will help you to understand your company’s Corporation Tax assessment and tell you what to do if you disagree with any of the figures shown.
changeNote: Information about how to pay has been added to 'Section 3.1'. Information about when HMRC amend the return and when there is an appeal has been added to 'Section 4.1'. Information about when HMRC amend the return and when there is an appeal has been added to 'Section 4.3'. Clarification about when and how to pay Corporation Tax has been added to 'Section 5.1'. Information about trading losses has been updated in 'Section 4.2'. Section 4.4, relating to 'Claims' has been removed. Information about consulting your accounts office has been removed from 'Section 5.2'.
